title: ECARM: Energy-Consistent Advanced Regional Model (Version 1.0.0)
description: ECARM is a modified dynamical core integrated into the WRF v4.2 modeling framework. It replaces the default ARW dynamical core with an energy-consistent discretization scheme that reduces spurious energy sources and sinks, minimizing numerical dissipation and dispersion. The dynamical core adopts the Lamb form of the Navier-Stokes equations with hydrostatic balance decomposition, using u, v, w, density, density-weighted temperature, and moisture as prognostic variables. The model compilation, execution, and output are fully compatible with standard WRF v4.2.

creators.name: Ren, X.-Y.
creators.affiliation: Institute of Atmospheric Physics， Chinese Academy of Sciences

notes: This software is based on the WRF model version 4.2, which is public domain software developed by NCAR/UCAR. Only the dynamical core (primarily in dyn_em/) has been replaced; all executable names, output file names, physics, and WPS compatibility remain identical to standard WRF v4.2.
